corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
import redis

router = APIRouter(prefix="/scheduler/beat")

class ScheduleToggle(BaseModel):
    enabled: bool

@router.patch("/schedules/{schedule_name}/toggle")
async def toggle_beat_schedule(
    schedule_name: str,
    payload: ScheduleToggle,
    redis_client: redis.Redis = Depends(get_redis_client),
    registry: ScheduleRegistry = Depends(get_schedule_registry),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if not registry.is_owner(current_user.tenant_id, schedule_name):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: You cannot modify this schedule")

    exists = redis_client.hexists("redbeat:schedules", schedule_name)
    if not exists:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Schedule not found")

    redis_client.hset(f"redbeat:schedule:{schedule_name}:meta", "enabled", int(payload.enabled))
    return {"schedule_name": schedule_name, "enabled": payload.enabled}
